children: On September 15, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq Staff Determination that it failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for 30 consecutive business days under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Due to a reverse stock split on December 1, 2025, the company is not eligible for the standard 180-day compliance period and will request a hearing, which will stay any suspension or delisting during the process; there is no assurance of the outcome.
